name: FeTaQA
description: FeTaQA is a dataset for free-form table question answering consisting of 10K Wikipedia-based tables with questions and free-form answers. It requires reasoning, integration, and natural language generation beyond short factual answers.
reputation: A well-known table QA benchmark for free-form answering that is commonly used to evaluate reasoning-heavy table understanding models.
notes: Challenges existing QA methods with free-form answers requiring advanced reasoning and text generation.
